name: LLM Superagent
description: An autonomous team for any LLM: your agent routes each request into a ticket and hands it to a worker sub-agent (code, research, analysis, review, docs) on the model from your list best suited to its type of task and requirements.
author: eskwisit

en.name: LLM Superagent
en.description: An autonomous team for any LLM: your agent routes each request into a ticket and hands it to a worker sub-agent (code, research, analysis, review, docs) on the model from your list best suited to its type of task and requirements.
en.safetyNotes: Agent tools plus a skill; no network access and no process execution. agent.prompt.inject indexes the LLM Superagent skill for the Skill tool. agent.tool.register adds seven tools the orchestrating agent calls (superagent_config, superagent_models, superagent_intake, superagent_route, superagent_eval_decide, superagent_reply, superagent_ticket). models.list reads which of your signed-in models you enabled for sub-agents (never any key) to pick each worker's model. fs.read and fs.write are scoped to .superagent/** in the workspace, where the team keeps its state, worker briefs and reports. Beyond the host file API the plugin uses Node fs only to copy its five superagent-worker-*.md sub-agents to ~/.agents/subagents on load (the only place PI-Desktop loads sub-agents from), remove them on unload unless you edited them, and read its own default team sections. Workers are ordinary PI-Desktop sub-agents: the code and docs workers can edit workspace files, and the code, research, analysis and review workers can run shell commands, with the permissions PI-Desktop grants sub-agents. The policy, role models, trait overrides, exclusions, notes, slots and team sections are plugin settings.

zh-CN.name: LLM 超级智能体
zh-CN.description: 适用于任何大模型的自主团队：你的智能体把每个请求转为一张工单，交给一个工作子智能体（代码、调研、分析、审查、文档），并从你的模型列表中挑选最适合该任务类型和要求的模型来运行。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 智能体工具加一个技能；不访问网络，插件本身不运行任何进程。agent.prompt.inject 用于为 Skill 工具索引 LLM 超级智能体技能。agent.tool.register 注册七个由编排智能体调用的工具（superagent_config、superagent_models、superagent_intake、superagent_route、superagent_eval_decide、superagent_reply、superagent_ticket）。models.list 读取你在已登录的模型中启用给子智能体的那些模型（从不读取任何密钥），用于为每个工作者挑选模型。fs.read 与 fs.write 仅限工作区中的 .superagent/**，团队在其中保存状态、工作简报和报告。在宿主文件 API 之外，插件仅用 Node fs 做以下事情：加载时将五个 superagent-worker-*.md 子智能体复制到 ~/.agents/subagents（PI-Desktop 唯一加载子智能体的位置），卸载时删除它们（你修改过的除外），以及读取插件自带的默认团队章节。工作者是普通的 PI-Desktop 子智能体：代码和文档工作者可以编辑工作区文件，代码、调研、分析和审查工作者可以运行 shell 命令，权限与 PI-Desktop 授予子智能体的相同。策略、角色模型、特性覆盖、排除项、备注、并发数和团队章节均保存在插件设置中。

changelog: Workers now read messages you send while they run before a ticket ends, limits fail over to another provider, and thinking levels and local model choices are fixed.

agentTools.name: superagent_config
agentTools.description: LLM Superagent: read or save the policy (accept mode, rules, allowed senders, admission), worker slots, eval timeout, pause, role models per task type, model trait overrides, exclusions and team sections; shows your sub-agent models with their inferred traits. Use only from the llm-superagent skill.

mode.description: set: accept mode for proactive (inferred) candidates

allowed.description: set: sender ids allowed to request work (default ["person"])

admission.description: set: { listedUnaddressed: inferred|ignore, unlistedAddressed: explicit|inferred|ignore, unlistedUnaddressed: inferred|ignore }

maxWorkers.description: set: concurrent worker turns, 1–8 (default 3); one extra slot is kept for a person's message

evalTimeoutSeconds.description: set: how long a candidate waits for a decision, 30–3600 (default 120)

paused.description: set: pause or resume processing (evals, launches, replies); messages are still recorded

roleModels.description: set: { taskType: [model, fallback, …] } pins; [] removes a pin

profiles.description: set: { glob: { reasoning|coding|writing|context|speed|cost: 1-5, vision|reasoningModel|unstable: bool, thinking: [levels] } }; null removes

exclude.description: set: model id globs never to use

team.description: set: { communication|scope|delivery: text }; "" restores the default

show.description: get: team sections to return in full

clear.description: set: forget role models, overrides, exclusions and notes first

agentTools.name: superagent_models
agentTools.description: LLM Superagent: preview which of your sub-agent models (with fallbacks and suggested thinking level) a task type and requirements would get. Use only from the llm-superagent skill.

requirements.description: Optional: quality low|normal|high|max, speed low|normal|high, budget low|normal|high, context short|normal|long|huge, vision bool, reasoning bool, thinking level, differentFrom [ticket ids whose model family to avoid], prefer [globs], avoid [globs]

explain.description: Also return the top 5 candidates with scores

agentTools.name: superagent_intake
agentTools.description: LLM Superagent: record a person's chat message as a trigger. A reply on a ticket's thread goes straight to that ticket's worker (follow-up); anything else goes through the gate to Eval and comes back as a candidate card. Use only from the llm-superagent skill.

addressed.description: false when the message is not addressed to you as a request (shared material, an aside, thinking aloud); default true

thread.description: Only when the message replies within an existing thread (answers a ticket's question, or follows up on its result): that thread key

agentTools.name: superagent_route
agentTools.description: LLM Superagent: decide waiting candidates, one item each: accept (new ticket, explicit requests only), attach (to a ticket the message points at), stop (a ticket, at the person's request) or ignore (with a reason). Items are processed independently. Use only from the llm-superagent skill.

trigger_id.description: The candidate card's trigger_id (a follow-up's for stop)

reason.description: ignore and stop: why, at most 500 characters

title.description: accept: a short label of the original request, at most 200 characters; no added requirements

name.description: accept: a short English name; it becomes the ticket id

acknowledgement.description: accept: one short sentence, at most 100 words, naming the concrete change and intended result, in the person's language

note.description: accept and attach: optional routing background or an explicit constraint of the person, at most 30 words; never instructions

type.description: accept: the type of task, which picks the worker and its model

requirements.description: Optional: quality low|normal|high|max, speed low|normal|high, budget low|normal|high, context short|normal|long|huge, vision bool, reasoning bool, thinking level, differentFrom [ticket ids whose model family to avoid], prefer [globs], avoid [globs]

scope.description: accept: one sentence naming the work the mandate allows; defaults to the title

agentTools.name: superagent_eval_decide
agentTools.description: LLM Superagent: record the assessment of a proactive (inferred) candidate against every enabled rule; accept creates a ticket only in auto mode and only with a settled direction and a matched rule. Use only from the llm-superagent skill.

rule_assessments.description: Exactly one entry per enabled rule

intent_evidence.description: accept: the three facts (this project, a change is wanted, direction settled) with source quotes

title.description: accept: a short label of the original request, at most 200 characters; no added requirements

name.description: accept: a short English name; it becomes the ticket id

acknowledgement.description: accept: one short sentence, at most 100 words, naming the concrete change and intended result, in the person's language

note.description: accept and attach: optional routing background or an explicit constraint of the person, at most 30 words; never instructions

type.description: accept: the type of task, which picks the worker and its model

requirements.description: Optional: quality low|normal|high|max, speed low|normal|high, budget low|normal|high, context short|normal|long|huge, vision bool, reasoning bool, thinking level, differentFrom [ticket ids whose model family to avoid], prefer [globs], avoid [globs]

scope.description: accept: one sentence naming the work the mandate allows; defaults to the title

agentTools.name: superagent_reply
agentTools.description: LLM Superagent: clear a message to the person by its purpose before you post it: result (a ready, completed or dropped ticket), attention (the ticket's open question, copied exactly) or answer (a question the worker answered); at most 100 words, never twice. Use only from the llm-superagent skill.

question.description: attention: the ticket's open question, exactly

agentTools.name: superagent_ticket
agentTools.description: LLM Superagent: list (what needs the person first), read, report (record a worker turn when its sub-agent returns), retry, recover (a turn lost to a restart), status, note, unsubscribe (a thread), requeue (a message to Eval), dismiss (an unavailable decision). Use only from the llm-superagent skill.

turn.description: report: the turn number that returned

attempt.description: report: the launch item's attempt number

outcome.description: report: the sub-agent returned, or failed (error, timeout, limit)

text.description: report: the sub-agent's reply, used only when it wrote no report file. note: one fact from other work, at most 100 words

model.description: retry: run on this model instead (a new worker session)

settings.title: Policy
settings.description: Accept mode (off, observe, auto), rules for proactive work, allowed senders and admission. Edit through the agent (superagent_config) rather than by hand.

settings.title: Concurrent workers
settings.description: Worker turns running at once (1–8); one extra slot is kept for your messages.

settings.title: Eval timeout (seconds)
settings.description: How long a candidate waits for a decision before it is queued again (30–3600).

settings.title: Paused
settings.description: Pause processing: messages are recorded, nothing is evaluated, launched or sent.

settings.title: Role models
settings.description: Models pinned per task type, { type: [model, fallback, …] }. Types: code, debug, test, research, analysis, review, docs. Empty means picked automatically from your list.

settings.title: Model trait overrides
settings.description: Corrections to inferred model traits, { glob: { reasoning|coding|writing|context|speed|cost: 1-5, vision: bool } }.

settings.title: Excluded models
settings.description: Glob patterns of model ids never used, e.g. ["*preview*"].

settings.title: Model notes
settings.description: Notes the orchestrator reads before routing, e.g. why a model is excluded.

settings.title: Team section: Communication
settings.description: Replaces the default Communication section every worker reads. Empty uses the default.

settings.title: Team section: Ticket scope
settings.description: Replaces the default Ticket scope section. Empty uses the default.

settings.title: Team section: Delivery requirements
settings.description: Replaces the default Delivery requirements section. Empty uses the default.

settings.title: Prompt revision
settings.description: Counts saves of the team sections; each brief records the revision it was written under.
